kind: New constructed boundary case, prepared before completing C27 fresh trials
established_events: Rowan has lived at the Academy for one week. On Thursday at noon he invited Caelindra and Seraphel to a reading in the common room on Friday after dinner. Both accepted.

At eight on Friday morning, Rowan learned that the common room would close for floor repairs that afternoon. He met Rashid alone and told him the reading could not happen there tonight; he had not yet found a replacement reservation.

At nine, Rowan spoke privately with the porter and reserved the east gardens for Saturday at four in the afternoon. He accepted this arrangement. No one else heard them, no notice was posted, and Rowan has told nobody the new location or time.

At noon, Rashid told Seraphel only that the common room was closed and Rowan was looking for a different reservation. Rashid did not know about the nine oclock agreement. Caelindra has heard neither report. Neither she nor Seraphel has spoken to the porter or seen the reservation record.
It is Friday just before dinner. Rowan, Caelindra and Seraphel are together in the dining hall. Rashid is elsewhere. There have been no further conversations or disclosures about the reading.
